status: ALL CASES NOT_RUN; neither native nor fake acceptance is claimed by this design commit
ownership: Only disposable explicitly owned fixtures in future separately authorized runs. No customer configuration, services, providers or real credentials. This turn creates no markers and executes no controller/Docker/platform code.
neutral_oracle: Judge observed identities and retained data, not implementation response text. A controller reporting succeeded with old image, wrong project, wrong version, missing data, unresolved migration or unverified health fails. Fake/source passes are distinct from Docker/platform proof.

future_runnable_controller_design.entrypoint: Proposed tests/update_owner/run_owned_lifecycle.py, not created/executed now. Future argv: [rtk, proxy, python3, tests/update_owner/run_owned_lifecycle.py, --mode, fake|owned-docker|native-platform, --fixture-root, ABS_OWNED_PATH, --case, Axx, --receipt-dir, ABS_PRIVATE_PATH]. No app/test conftest import chain.
controller_interface: step(clock, journal, compose_adapter, image_adapter, health_adapter, startup_event_adapter) -> persisted_snapshot

adapter_contracts.ProcessRunner: accept literal argv + explicit cwd + private environment, return exit code/stdout/stderr bounded internally; preserve full durable redacted receipt. No shell interpolation. Operator validation subprocess argv begins rtk proxy. Customer product adapters invoke installed Docker/platform binaries directly, with no RTK dependency.
adapter_contracts.ComposeAdapter: construct original docker context, project directory/name, ordered -f and env files plus last owner override; privately resolve and compare config; capture compose up exit directly; inspect project/service/image/mounts after action. No global cleanup.
adapter_contracts.ImageAdapter: Resolve authenticated allowed tag and index/platform/config identities; pull exact platform reference and compare existing version label or equivalent immutable evidence. No mandatory new manifest.
adapter_contracts.JournalAndLock: stdlib fake uses TemporaryDirectory and injected clock; native adapter uses real OS locks/fsync/atomic replace and process-tree supervision. Expose fault hook at each durable boundary.
adapter_contracts.FixtureManager: future owned-Docker mode records ownership manifest before creating anything; unique project/ports/fixture volumes, synthetic auth/config/serial/data; retain original Docker-socket mount/authority for option C fixture, record presence and cooperative-only limits; also exercise preexisting no-socket variant. Markers are made only in future owned fixtures.
adapter_contracts.ObservationAdapter: read expected fixture app/Postgres/Qdrant/import identity/data using fixture-owned tooling; exact pre/post comparisons remain private, receipt records only pass booleans/owned resource ids and digests of nonsensitive fixtures. No provider calls.
adapter_contracts.MailboxAndStatus: Bounded authenticated transport across client A / daemon B with no shared filesystem, durable A ack/journal and status-file/CLI/launcher, app API snapshot copy/resync; archive proposal or equivalent outcomes accepted. Read-only status grants no update rights.

run_phases: Validate explicit owned fixture manifest and isolated mode before enabling native adapters; default fake mode never opens network/socket.
Prepare old pinned fixture and original context variants, snapshot original identities privately, then drive same UI/owner protocol as product.
Inject selected failure/crash boundary; poll independently and enforce external watchdog using phase deadlines plus cleanup budget.
Compare all expected image/version/health/context/data observations independently of controller status; emit structured per-case receipt, failures and uncropped redacted logs.

Cleanup only resources named by owned manifest after preserving receipt; cleanup failure is separate failed result and leaves precise resource inventory. Never broad prune/down on arbitrary current directory.
receipt_schema: case id, mode/proof layer, platform/arch and tool versions
fixture ownership id, context variant and original/selected/observed identity
timestamped durable phases and external observations
individual assertion pass/fail/unknown, exit codes, timeout/fault injection point
preservation comparisons as booleans, not credentials or resolved env
full private redacted stdout/stderr paths and hashes; UI/status trace
future_runnable_controller_design.success_policy: All applicable assertions must pass in their actual layer. Missing platform, browser, channel, migration or preservation observations remain NOT_RUN/UNKNOWN; no aggregation from fake tests into native success. Native runs await future authorization and R339 release of boundary.

cases.setup: Original customer Compose defaults old v1.20.47 in image AND env; owned fixture has old container/image id and known distinct target digest.
cases.trigger: One authenticated UI click for target release.
assertions: Owner ack precedes app disconnect; exact target only pulled; new container id differs and local image id matches target platform digest.

Reported/build version maps to chosen authenticated release via existing label or equivalent evidence and exact platform image identity. Health stable for configured N >= 1 observations/interval or equivalent justified proof; no requirement for three/five-second samples or new metadata. Old cached image alone fails.

cases.setup: Complete A01 with stale exported VECTORAIZ_VERSION=old and old .env pin.
cases.trigger: Normal stop/start through each real integrated launcher, then installer rerun in same context.
assertions: Same target digest/version selected, no up --build, no downloaded Compose overwrite; same installation id and data.
Record actual root, Mac .app, Linux desktop/optional boot unit, root and platform Windows launcher paths; no untested platform claim.

cases.setup: Owned path with spaces/non-ASCII, custom -p distinct from directory, --project-directory, ordered -f files, last override, two --env-file files, default .env alternatives, exported variables including stale version; Docker context explicitly recorded. Exercise local Desktop/VM, native Linux and working two-host A Compose client/config/owner -> B daemon/app, browser C, with no shared filesystem or extra proxy/listener. Existing bind sources belong to B.
assertions: Original config resolution retained except exact release selector and explicit owner fields; literal final override wins both old pins.

Preserve relative paths, ports, networks, service env_file and all mount targets/options; retain override order and shell precedence for non-version values. Compare resolved data privately; receipt exposes booleans and fixture ids only.
Run separate cases for COMPOSE_FILE, Compose name, external/renamed volumes and bind mounts; do not infer identity from directory basename.

Bounded authenticated submit/complete durable ack before 202 crosses original Docker context; owner A continues while B app absent, recreates original project/service, re-pairs verified replacement and restores status. No A-path bind assumption/helper container/new SSH grant.

Image-created non-mounted mailbox ownership/modes allow current root app writer and existing owner context archive access; A private OS ACLs protect journal/pairing and read-only status. Validate actual configured limits and reject partial/stale/cross-generation/wrong-container/wrong-MAC ack; no untrusted tar extraction/link following. Equivalent bounded transport may satisfy outcomes without cp.

cases.setup: Owned synthetic app/keystore/serial/HMAC/encryption files, authenticated synthetic account, PostgreSQL row, Qdrant point and import bind file. Capture before identity and readback; no real credentials/provider/serial API.
assertions: Same original app/Postgres/Qdrant/import mount identities and contents; original auth works with preserved serial/keystore, no provisioning calls/new credentials.
Dependency container ids and images unchanged; no fresh project/parallel blank installation. Byte comparisons private; no secrets in receipt.

Record original/post-activation Docker socket mount presence and unchanged existing authority under explicit option C. Mailbox limits are cooperative only, no privilege reduction/compromised-app containment. Preserve customer mounts and no-socket variants; no Compose !override/!reset version requirement.

cases.setup: Two users/tabs, same target and competing target; lost acknowledgement retry.
cases.trigger: Simultaneous same-key/same-payload, same-key/different-payload, same-target/different-key, different-target requests and normal launcher.
assertions: Exactly one active mutation; same key/payload returns same id; same target joins; conflicts return 409/active id. Launcher waits/joins lock.
Owner restart does not create second operation; idempotency survives app replacement; stale requests cannot overwrite target.

cases.setup: Owned target reference unavailable or registry failure injected by fixture adapter; current healthy old deployment.
assertions: failed_download within bound; old selection/image/container/data remain; no latest fallback or false updating/succeeded.
Retry linked new attempt may succeed exact same chosen digest; no unbounded queued retries.

cases.setup: Adapter emits nonzero before replacement, and separate case after partial recreation.
assertions: Actual child exit captured (no pipeline swallowing); observed active image recorded independently.
Before-replacement old remains; partial replacement inspects actual new/unknown state and reports recovery_required without unsafe blind revert.

cases.setup: Target unhealthy, wrong reported version, wrong image digest, wrong project, health endpoint belonging to old/unrelated app: separate variants.
assertions: No variant succeeds merely on HTTP 200 or expected environment string; exact project/service/image/build version plus stable health mandatory.
Bounded failure with actual/unknown observed fields; independent status remains available.

cases.setup: Owned synthetic database and fixture target whose entrypoint migration phase fails; separately target exits before phase telemetry. No production migration imported by fake suite.
assertions: migration_failed only when phase event establishes it; otherwise startup_failed_migration_unconfirmed. No success/reload countdown.
Config/data intact; no automatic database/image downgrade, credential generation or deletion. Original recovery context retained; forward repair/retry specified.

After configured bounded owner observation record recovery_required and terminal host status, retain original restart policy and report app may continue migration/restart loop. No automatic app stop or image/database rollback; owner restarts never renew full observation budget.

cases.setup: Durable owner ack; app or UI killed before/after replacement, lost POST response.
cases.trigger: Restart app/UI or refresh status page.
assertions: Owner completes independent of app lifespan; UI reconnects to same operation; last_verified differs from desired until verified.
Persistent journal/status survives; lost acknowledgement resubmission deduplicates.
Persist pre-submit correlation/key; lost ack deduplicates before/after expiry/reload. Recovered authenticated app current/id or host history returns same operation; partial copy never valid 202/ack.

Confirmed pre-submission owner refusal has no side effects; timeout after handoff reports acceptance_unknown and looks up/retries SAME idempotency key. A committed-but-undelivered ack may proceed, never falsely promise no mutation or mint a duplicate operation.

cases.setup: Fault after each journal write/rename, pull start/end, selector/override commit, Compose start/end and final verification.
cases.trigger: Kill only owned owner process, restart supervisor and reconcile.
assertions: One OS lock/mutation; durable intent restores consistent generation; inspect before replay. Same target and remaining deadline, no repeat full budget.
Target running -> verify; old running -> bounded continuation only with unchanged context; unknown state -> recovery_required. Completed state does not reactivate.

Reconcile original dependencies before app-only activation; start stopped existing containers in original context and health-wait within remaining configured budget, with unchanged ids/images/config/data and no recreation. Missing/mismatched dependencies produce truthful recovery state, not inferred migration failure.

Owner A journal/status survive B container replacement; reacquire exact original project/service/image, new epoch and snapshot resync. Daemon absence does not block host file/CLI reads or justify replay/new operation.

cases.setup: Prepared owned installation with operation in progress and Docker temporarily unavailable.
cases.trigger: Reboot owned native fixture; logon/headless startup per supported platform.
assertions: Supervisor resumes under original user/context; owner/app remain separate; daemon absence produces bounded truthful status.
No extra service/permission assumption; Linux user-session/linger behavior and Windows scheduled task/mac LaunchAgent lifecycle evidenced separately.

Reconcile original dependencies before app-only activation; start stopped existing containers in original context and health-wait within remaining configured budget, with unchanged ids/images/config/data and no recreation. Missing/mismatched dependencies produce truthful recovery state, not inferred migration failure.

Owner A journal/status survive B container replacement; reacquire exact original project/service/image, new epoch and snapshot resync. Daemon absence does not block host file/CLI reads or justify replay/new operation.

cases.setup: Actual old app/Compose without protocol, owner or image mailbox; variants missing optional installer metadata, equivalent original invocation available, missing original .env, ambiguous custom mappings.
cases.trigger: Run future verified host adopter in original context; also submit update while owner missing.
assertions: Old source publication does not change host; no automatic in-app adoption claim. Unavailable POST has no Docker side effects.
Equivalent context accepted despite optional metadata absent; uncertain original config/data stops before changes; preserve original recovery instructions.
After adoption, actual launch paths use owner and first protocol-capable activation is verified; subsequent user update is one click. Never execute legacy overwriting installer for adoption.

One-time verified adoption establishes future scoped pairing/host ACLs without changing original credentials/socket/custom mounts or granting new Docker/SSH access. No required listener/proxy/default numeric constants/new metadata artifact; protocol-capable subsequent updates fully activate in one click.

cases.setup: Original Compose/env source or mounts change after preflight or owner restart.
cases.trigger: Attempt activation under same recorded generation.
assertions: Material effective configuration or source ownership/access mismatch stops before activation; active original context untouched. Re-resolve privately and accept harmless comments/formatting/optional metadata changes when effective configuration, ownership and release identity remain equivalent. Require concrete recapture evidence for material changes rather than guessing or a generic approval loop.

cases.setup: Oversized request/log stream, stalled registry/Compose/health, stale heartbeat, repeated owner restarts and terminal history overflow. Include malicious/truncated/extra-member tar, links, interrupted copy, old epoch replay and configured non-default limits.
cases.trigger: Advance fake clock; inject same delays in owned fixture.
assertions: Test effective configured finite request/snapshot/log/archive/member/phase/copy/kill/poll/heartbeat/stale/retention limits, deadlines and stability policy, including justified non-default settings. Design numbers are provisional default values under test, not product acceptance gates. Persist limits and remaining budget across every crash; heartbeat default 5 seconds / stale 15 seconds consistently.
No false percent/success, active/recovery state never evicted, remaining budget survives crash, unresolved child blocks mutation. Public output redacted; fake clock evidence explicitly fake.

cases.setup: Authenticated app on local Desktop/native Linux and working two-host remote context; durable host status file/CLI/launcher on A. Force app/nginx unavailable permanently, elapsed former read-token lifetime, UI refresh, owner restart, lost correlation, denied notification/native permissions.
cases.trigger: Submit once, force startup/migration failure; observe loaded browser unreachable display and independently recover same operation on A while failed app never returns.
assertions: Existing authenticated app status API is primary when available. Loaded UI shows last phase/time/deadline and unreachable/unknown on HTTP error; full refresh may not load app and never fabricates success/failure. No expiring browser read capability or failed-app renewal dependency.

A private durable bounded terminal status file always exists; existing OS-authorized read-only CLI and launcher status UI recover same operation without app/nginx, daemon or running owner. After owner restart reconcile same journal/generation, mark stale/unknown honestly until observed. Read-only status/file never grants update authority or reveals keys/config/serial.

Native notification delivered where available; denial/absent session is not false product success. Prove file/CLI fallback independently. Native permission/supervision failures remain failed/unknown evidence, never inferred acceptance.

Lost ack/key/id/page reload recovers via host current/history and, when app returns, authenticated current/id API; no duplicate mutation or old success reused. Elapsed request-key/expiry does not erase acknowledged journal/status. Active/unresolved recovery retained until explicit reconciliation; no expiring host read authorization tied to app.

Two-host case works without shared filesystem, new listener, browser bearer token or independent proxy route. Browser-only C need not receive live terminal status while app is down; A launcher/CLI/file provide independently authorized recovery. No secrets or public arbitrary-command endpoint; security implementation remains unproved, held scanner not executed.

Reject unauthenticated submit/status app API access, wrong paired app/principal/installation identity, missing update scope, invalid MAC and expired/replayed fresh requests; no side effects or authority granted by status reads. Acked operation remains recoverable after request expiry. Keep reasons behind existing authentication and public capability boolean only; no auth metadata exposure expansion.

cases.setup: Direct, marketplace and aim-data registration fixtures with allowed repository and equivalent authenticated release evidence; target tag moves after resolution.
assertions: Frozen digest used throughout; no latest pull and no repository crossing. Marketplace retains original presentation/config.
AIM-Data adapter disabled without its own release evidence; aim-data-data never mapped to vectoraiz-data. This repo cannot attest another release train.

cases.setup: Pull failure, partial Compose, startup/migration failure; retained original private config and valid forward-repair fixture.
cases.trigger: Retry through owner after reconciling actual state; exercise runbook missing-original-config refusal.
assertions: Attempt history and actual image preserved; no old safe result reused as current success; exact target verified after repair.

No down -v/prune/reset/new secrets or serial; image fallback only with separately evidenced schema compatibility. Missing original .env recovery cannot bypass through equivalent-looking generated credentials.

cases.setup: Future controller and adapters imported alone with stdlib unittest/tempfile/json and fake clock/process/filesystem.
cases.trigger: Source parse target files and invoke fake controller; no application imports, conftest, daemon/socket/network/DB.
assertions: Check target-selection/argv assembly, persistent transaction/replay, limits, state transitions and no false success. Future fake coverage includes bounded archive/partial-copy rejection, epoch/ack recovery, status read-only contract, dependency readiness and configured limits; no fake is executed now.
Fakes test controller behavior only, never prove real Compose preservation, migrations, authentication integration or native platform lifecycle.

turn_safe_validation: Only parse three design JSON files with stdlib, compare source hashes and Git diff against exact base, and inspect publication metadata. No fake controller implementation or application tests created.
holds: R289 SQLSandbox and its source/artifacts/tests/reviews/import chains remain excluded, R328 scanner hold unchanged, R339 native local services forbidden. Searches exclude !**/*sandbox*, !**/*Sandbox*, !**/security/**. No subagents/reviewer dispatch. Vulcan13893 backend/data-verification/Stripe/config freeze remains active.
